targetLedger.source: R1 protocol dispositions, exact IDs and original nominal windows
targetLedger.denominatorPolicy: retain every original target and every exclusion; never reduce denominator to available predictions

history.builder: existing V1 verified history/feature builder, unchanged
history.cutoff: started_at < target_start AND completed_at < target_start, exclude target
history.onlineState: earlier validation/calibration/test outcomes may update chronological Elo after completion, never fitted weights or thresholds
history.sameSeriesEarlierMaps: allowed only as strictly completed chronological history; not live between-map product
history.historyPool: independently verified earlier pro maps; target split membership is not history eligibility

features.orientation: Team A smaller numeric canonical team ID, B larger; map side mapping verified
features.heroEncoding: signed presence: +1 Team A, -1 Team B, 0 absent; 10 distinct heroes
features.heroVocabulary: ascending hero IDs from train maps only
features.unseenHero: post model unavailable, paired cohort excludes with reason; retain baseline-only denominator
features.preprocessing: no fitted centering, no imputation, no data-dependent scaling

models.M0: unchanged fixed V1 Elo, no calibrator
models.M1: L2 logistic regression on elo feature only
models.M2: L2 logistic regression on same elo plus signed heroes
models.selection: minimum validation log loss; tie within 1e-12 selects smaller C
models.convergenceFailure: candidate invalid; no silent max_iter/parameter change
models.coefficientFitting: train only; validation chooses C independently for M1 and M2
models.trainingCohort: identical final verified train examples for M1 and M2
models.selectionCohort: identical common-eligibility validation maps for M1/M2; preserve full denominator

calibration.method: positive temperature scaling of selected frozen logits
calibration.cohort: identical common-eligibility calibration maps for M1/M2

sampleFloors.meaning: operational research floors, not power analysis or accuracy guarantee

evaluation.primary: paired log-loss delta M2_cal - M1_cal on exact same eligible maps
secondary: Brier deltas against M0 and M1_cal
accuracy, N maps/series, source and history coverage
provider-patch/date/league strata with N; provider patch is not verified release context
evaluation.pairedSample: intersection of M0/M1/M2 predeclared eligibility; report full target ledger and baseline-only scores separately
evaluation.reliabilityBins: 10 equal-width probability bins; empty bin rate null

bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, exploratory, not a new blind-test guarantee

researchSignalRequires: all sample floors and provenance/parity checks
paired coverage >= 0.80 of planned development_test target map denominator
upper 95% series-bootstrap CI of primary log-loss delta < 0
mean M2_cal Brier <= both M0 and M1_cal
evaluation.firstResult: record once including insufficient/negative; corrections append a new linked revision

release.futureIndependentStudy: separate registration after executable/candidate freeze; do not reuse these dates as untouched holdout
mustAddress: post-draft feature/patch scope deviation from full S3-04
Python/TS artifact parity and pinned environment
independent temporal evaluation and explicit activation
release.existingV1Protocol: unchanged, no sharing or overriding its future observation window

environment.state: to provision and freeze before fitting; no installs or fitting in protocol step

parameters.artifact: exact R1 artifact bytes including M1/M2 coefficients, C, vocabulary, feature order and temperatures
parameters.M0: same initial1500/K32/scale400 Elo policy; recompute chronological state with exact added history
parameters.baseline: M0 M1 M2 all receive the same R2 historical snapshot
parameters.trainAndValidation: must reproduce R1 eligibility, ordered features and labels exactly or stop
parameters.calibration: do not refit or choose temperatures on changed history; preserve R1 temperatures; report possible calibration drift

data.source: frozen coverage capture; retain original target facts and add only approved 28 history IDs
data.availability: conditional_event_time_assumed; reconstructed lineups/heroes; no known_at backdating
data.strictCutoff: history.started_at < target.started_at AND history.completed_at < target.started_at; exclude target
data.series: revalidate all known series members including history-only siblings; reject conflicts, unknown/incomplete series and boundary crossing
data.identities: exact canonical player/account evidence; no nick merges; reject drift in original history
data.draft: 10 distinct final heroes on verified native sides; full draft timeline not required for hero-only diagnostic
data.scope: one verified professional map, any known/unknown map number; not a first-map or series-win claim
data.tournamentTier: record source/tier or null; no manual Tier1 gate or invented tier; no Tier1-specific conclusion from this mixed corpus

evaluation.primary: paired log-loss delta M2_cal - M1_cal on exact same eligible maps
secondary: Brier deltas against M0 and M1_cal
accuracy, N maps/series, source and history coverage
provider-patch/date/league strata with N; provider patch is not verified release context
evaluation.pairedSample: intersection of M0/M1/M2 predeclared eligibility; report full target ledger and baseline-only scores separately
evaluation.reliabilityBins: 10 equal-width probability bins; empty bin rate null

bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, exploratory, not a new blind-test guarantee

researchSignalRequires: all sample floors and provenance/parity checks
paired coverage >= 0.80 of planned development_test target map denominator
upper 95% series-bootstrap CI of primary log-loss delta < 0
mean M2_cal Brier <= both M0 and M1_cal
evaluation.firstResult: record once including insufficient/negative; corrections append a new linked revision
evaluation.interpretation: exploratory sensitivity only; coverage-driven selection was informed by R1; no independent confirmation
comparisons: R2 M2_cal versus R2 M1_cal and R2 M0 on identical available maps
R2 versus R1 for each fixed model on the exact common eligible target IDs
newly recovered targets separately with N and reasons; do not attribute cohort-composition changes to accuracy gains

independentEvaluation.earliestPermittedStart: strictly after final candidate/evaluator/source-policy registration; actual UTC dates must be registered before collection
requirements: freeze candidate, feature builder, environment, calibration and evaluator before new target series begin
register source/event-edition universe, fixed date window, sample floors and one terminal assessment in advance
audit outcome-blind enrollment ledger and series aliases against all prior exposed targets
capture final10 heroes, lineups, identities and histories with stage timestamps before map start; preserve misses/cancellations/mismatches
link only verified actual professional map outcomes separately after completion
preserve whole-series splits, unavailable denominator and strata; source/completeness gaps remain explicit
resolve hero/patch scope and validate Python/TS parity before any release decision
independentEvaluation.stopping: insufficient at the registered deadline stays insufficient; no extension or retuning chosen from observed performance
independentEvaluation.existingV1Window: not changed, shared or silently repurposed
